attemptDetails.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production FAR/background layer for a side-scrolling pixel-art game
Primary request: Create AF02 FAR, Namibia — Sossusvlei dunes, as one crisp pixel-art panoramic PNG.
Input images: Images 1-3 are immutable NA01 style references only for pixel-art rendering language, palette discipline, hard-edged clustered pixels, and layer density. Image 4 is the location/subject reference and governs the Sossusvlei dune shapes and color.
Scene/backdrop: A cloudless, fully opaque cool blue sky over pale cool distant dune ridges and sweeping rust-orange Namib dunes.
Subject: One dominant high dune crest, clearly readable, with a sharp ridge separating a bright terracotta sunlit plane from a deep rust/mauve shadow plane. Keep lower scenery useful behind later transparent MID and GROUND layers.
Style/medium: Crisp authored 2D pixel art matching the attached NA01 assets; deliberate blocky pixel clusters, limited game palette, hard clean contours, no antialiasing haze, no painterly or photoreal texture.
Composition/framing: Exact source canvas 2172 × 724 pixels, extremely wide panorama. The dominant dune crest must sit well away from both horizontal repeat joins, around the central-right interior, with broad sweeping shoulders. Keep the horizon and focal crest legible after runtime draw at scale 1.25 into a 960×540 viewport. Edge regions should carry low, unobtrusive distant ridges and compatible sky so horizontal repetition reads naturally, without duplicated landmark peaks at the seam. Dune foundation extends fully to the bottom edge.
Lighting/mood: Strong clear desert sun; sharp sunlit-versus-shadow plane on the main dune; warm and expansive.
Color palette: Rust, terracotta, burnt orange, pale cream, restrained mauve shadows, cool opaque blue sky.
Constraints: Exactly 2172×724. Fully opaque across every pixel, including all corners. One single continuous landscape, no panels, no borders. FAR layer only. Preserve a clear sky with no clouds. No characters or animals, including no oryx. No vegetation, trees, savannah grasses, cacti, mesas, rock towers, buildings, hazards, trail objects, text, UI, logos, or watermark. Do not copy NA01 subject matter. Do not place the dominant crest at either edge. Horizontal left/right edges should be visually compatible for repeating without an obvious cliff or abrupt color discontinuity.
